authorization_reference: Human authorization: Execute First Controlled Delivery
failure_reasons: No approved contact-form provider adapter or configured contact-form endpoint exists.
No browser or supported form-submission execution capability is available.
No operator-controlled reply address is available to complete the form without fabrication.
The delivery runtime remains disabled and has no configured delivery credentials.
required_resolution: Provide an operator-controlled browser submission path and sender reply identity outside source control.
Or implement and approve a provider-specific ICME contact-form adapter with confirmation capture.
Re-authorize only after the selected execution path can produce independent delivery evidence.
